items.label: WHO DARES WINS{00}{00}
items.why: The short program at $02A7 installs the loader entry and waits before entering the header code.

items.label: WHO DARES WINS{00}{00} (header)
items.why: The KERNAL loads this header at $033C. Its code from $0351 identifies and reads the fast blocks.

items.label: pulses 44954-472650
items.problem: 427,697 pulses in a format the kit does not decode, most of them 312 or 432 cycles long
items.why: Header pulses 49603 and 136180 decode to $A000–$C7FF and $0900–$9FFF. Both XOR checksums pass and the payloads match all 48896 entry bytes. The remaining pulses provide sync, gaps and the following recording lead-in.

items.label: WDW{00}{00}{00}{00}{00}{00}{00}{00}{00}{00}{00}{00}{00}
items.why: The second recording starts with a short program at $02A7, in front of the same resident game.

items.label: WDW{00}{00}{00}{00}{00}{00}{00}{00}{00}{00}{00}{00}{00} (header)
items.why: The second tape recording carries its own KERNAL header with the fast reader at $0351.

items.label: pulses 490469-891031
items.problem: 400,563 pulses in a format the kit does not decode, most of them 312 or 432 cycles long
items.why: Header pulses 495118 and 809023 decode to the same two byte-identical ranges in reverse order. Both checksums pass and the final header transfers control to $4000.
